doc.title: Sonny Igoe interviewed by Monk Rowe, Emerson, New Jersey, July 31, 2003

title: Bobby Rosengarden, anniversary and closing
summary: Igoe credits Bobby Rosengarden for NBC work, mentions age and 52-year marriage, and they wrap up.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well you’ve had an amazing career.
I’ve had a lot of fun.

And I’ve had a lot of people help me. A friend of yours, Bobby Rosengarden helped me by hiring me at NBC, getting NBC to hire me as his sub so he could go out and make more money recording. Bobby was a great guy, I liked him, I always liked him. And he was a boisterous kind of guy and would run around hollering and screaming and all like that. But he was a much better drummer than people gave him credit for.
Um hum. He’s been up to the college a number of times too.
He’s been up to the college a number of times.
How long have you been married now?
How long have you been married now?
52 years I think it is. Sure. My little dancing darling.
Well I want to thank you for your time.
Well it’s been my pleasure. I hope I didn’t hog everything.
No, no. I got what I was after, let’s put it that way.
I think you will enjoy watching it too.
I’m not one of those cult kind of people, as far as that goes. Nothing mysterious about me I don’t think.
